---
title: "JPEG open-graph image keeps its declared size"
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/mark.jpg">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:height" content="892">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">'
        - []
---

With `site-url` set, the declared `image-width` and `image-height` are kept for an image whose size Quarto cannot read.
